message: type Options doesn't implement trait `Copy` (required by `.copy()`): its part Chan[sync.Slot[i32]] doesn't
help: a copied queue has no clear meaning, and a copy that shared it would be a second owner of its state (a `sync.Lock` is a Chan inside); to change one field of a record that holds a Lock or Chan, build the record from its parts, as `Options(self.metrics, t)`, which shares the handle on purpose
